interface_checks.id_and_order_mapping: static_pass: renderer ID1/ID2 is tied to candidate identity; id_swap changes candidate-to-ID assignment and display_order_swap changes panel order independently; the runner inverts visible_ID_by_canonical to bind A=ID1 and B=ID2
interface_checks.image_text_removal: static_pass: v2 panel does not draw the passed label parameter, so caption, clock, and panel-position text are removed from the rendered RGB; only the red candidate ID marker and box remain
interface_checks.crop_geometry: static_pass_with_edge_case: crop box coordinates use rounded crop pixel origin and final resized crop width/height, matching the crop affine transform; zero-pixel crop dimensions are not checked before division when computing scale2
interface_checks.query_boundary: static_pass: C facts prompt has no query parameter and the runner does not append the caption to that request; query is used for B and the later text-only C alignment
interface_checks.b_c_visual_budget_and_time: static_pass: one rendered eight-frame list is passed to B and C facts, split into four two-frame clips; per-clip FPS is source FPS divided by the selected physical-frame gap and runner checks processor second_per_grid_ts against 2/FPS
interface_checks.sparse_supervision_scope: static_pass_with_scope_limit: source script labels its constructed receipt as forced CPU interface testing only; it records zero actual teacher-verified anchors and zero student fits
interface_checks.own_unit_guard: static_pass_with_caveats: cgroup path is restricted to stvg-query-alignment-002.service, launcher starts monitor before worker, and guard signal targets that exact unit; no elapsed-time stop is implemented

findings.detail: _context_decode explicitly permits a correct optional schema key at lines 17-18, but dict(schema=schema, **obj) raises TypeError when obj already contains schema. The normal synthetic contract tests only the schema-omitted form and therefore miss the advertised optional-version path.
findings.minimal_fix: Normalize with a non-colliding mapping operation, such as obj.setdefault('schema', schema) followed by serialization, while preserving exact semantic keys and rejecting a wrong explicit schema.

findings.detail: The requested C facts example contains "B":{same six string fields}, which is explanatory text rather than valid JSON. A strict parser rejects a literal or partial reproduction of this shape.
findings.minimal_fix: Describe the exact A/B object field set in prose or provide a fully valid compact example with all six B fields.

findings.detail: The C facts request omits the query as intended, but visual_note still sends timestamps, panel-ID ordering, inside/context flags, and candidate intervals as text; the schema prompt also says to use physical times and inside/context flags. This is not query leakage, but it means boundary/order facts are not strictly visual-only and may follow supplied interval metadata despite the no-copy instructions.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep these metadata fields only if they are an intentional part of the facts protocol; otherwise provide timing solely through video timestamps and withhold interval/inside summaries from C facts.

findings.detail: A legal positive-area normalized box can still round to a zero-width or zero-height pixel crop. scale2 divides by detail.width and detail.height before any minimum-size guard, so such an input raises ZeroDivisionError.
findings.minimal_fix: Check crop pixel width/height immediately after crop-coordinate rounding and explicitly reject or safely skip a degenerate crop before scale2.

findings.detail: Sampling failures are logged and the monitor continues without stopping its owned unit. Persistent cgroup or nvidia-smi failures therefore remove effective headroom protection and can rewrite the error receipt every 250 ms.
findings.minimal_fix: Treat persistent sampler failure as loss of guard coverage and stop only the owned unit, with bounded/backed-off error reporting.

findings.detail: The monitor is created only by the launcher. Invoking run_stvg_query_alignment_v2.py directly bypasses this resource guard; execution must remain through the launcher inside the dedicated systemd unit.
